```text
1	# Supported agents
2	
3	MEMO captures one agent today: **Claude Code**. Everything else is either planned or
4	out of scope. Fill the "verified on" rows during the P6 end-to-end run.
5	
6	## Claude Code
7	
8	| Item | Value |
9	|---|---|
10	| Capture method | hooks in `~/.claude/settings.json` → `memo capture` reads the session transcript |
11	| Hook events used | `SessionStart` (also prints the project context), `Stop`, `PreCompact`, `SessionEnd` |
12	| Transcript format | JSONL, one message per line, read incrementally by byte offset |
13	| Installed by | `memo setup claude` (backs the settings file up first, idempotent) |
14	| Removed by | `memo setup claude --remove` |
15	| Version verified | _fill in: `claude --version` output used for the P6 run_ |
16	| Terminal (PowerShell) | _fill in: pass / fail_ |
17	| Terminal (Git Bash) | _fill in: pass / fail_ |
18	| VS Code extension | _fill in: pass / fail_ |
19	
20	### How it works
21	
22	1. A session starts → `SessionStart` fires → MEMO records the transcript path in
23	   `~/.memo/state/<repoId>/cursors.json` and prints `memo context` to stdout, which
24	   Claude Code adds to the session context.
25	2. Each turn end (`Stop`), each compaction (`PreCompact`) and the session end
26	   (`SessionEnd`) fire → MEMO reads only the bytes after the stored offset, normalizes
27	   them into event envelopes, redacts them and appends to
28	   `.memory/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.jsonl`.
29	3. Every 15 minutes `memo cycle` sweeps anything the hooks missed, extracts records and
30	   commits `.memory/`.
31	
32	### Known limits
33	
34	- **Two sessions in the same repo at once** — both are captured, but their events
35	  interleave in separate files; cross-session consolidation is P7/P8 work.
36	- **Resumed or forked sessions** reuse the same session id: capture continues from the
37	  stored offset, so a fork may be recorded under the parent id.
38	- **Compaction rewrite** — if Claude Code rewrites the transcript file shorter than the
39	  stored offset, MEMO logs `transcript_rewritten`, resets the offset to 0 and re-reads;
40	  event ids make the re-read idempotent.
41	- **Subagent transcripts** are not captured (P8).
42	- **Worktrees and branch switches** — the repo root is resolved per hook call; a second
43	  worktree of the same repo is a separate root and needs its own `memo init`.
44	- **Transcript retention** — if Claude Code deletes old transcripts
45	  (`cleanupPeriodDays`) before a sweep runs, those events are lost; the hooks normally
46	  capture them long before that.
47	- **Hook failures are silent by design**: `memo capture` always exits 0 and logs to
48	  `~/.memo/logs/capture.jsonl`, so a MEMO problem never breaks your session.
49	
50	## Not supported yet
51	
52	| Agent | Status |
53	|---|---|
54	| Codex CLI | planned, P9 — needs an adapter in `src/capture/codex.js` |
55	| Cursor / Windsurf / Copilot Chat | no stable local transcript + hook contract checked yet |
56	| Plain `git` usage without an agent | partially: the post-commit hook writes `.memory/progress.md` |
57	
58	## Adding another agent
59	
60	1. Write `src/capture/<agent>.js` with a `normalize(line, ctx) → envelope[]` function
61	   that produces the §6.1 envelope (`type`, `id`, `seq`, `ts`, `agent`, `text`, `ok`).
62	2. Reuse `src/capture/capture.js` for cursors, locking, dedup and session files.
63	3. Add redacted fixture transcripts under `test/fixtures/<agent>/` and a
64	   `test/capture-<agent>.test.js` that runs offline.
65	4. Add the install path (hooks, wrapper or polling) and document it here.
66
```

16	```
17	memo init        # set up .memory/ and the post-commit hook in a repo
18	memo note        # add a note
19	memo report      # regenerate .memory/PROJECT_STATE.md
20	memo status      # show state; `memo doctor` diagnoses problems
21	memo console     # interactive menu

25	## Where memory lives
26	- `.memory/` (tracked): progress log, decisions, errors, next steps, `PROJECT_STATE.md`.

```text
1	'use strict';
2	
3	// `memo context` — compact, factual project state for a new agent session (≤ 8,000 chars).
4	// Printed by the SessionStart path of `memo capture`; Claude Code adds stdout to context.
5	
6	const fs = require('node:fs');
7	const path = require('node:path');
8	const { repoRoot } = require('./git');
9	const { memoryDir } = require('./paths');
10	const repos = require('./repos');
11	const state = require('./report/state');
12	
13	const MAX_CHARS = 8000;
14	
15	function buildContext(root, { maxChars = MAX_CHARS } = {}) {
16	  const { all, index } = state.loadState(root);
17	  const of = (type, statuses) => all.filter((r) => r.type === type && statuses.includes(r.status));
18	  const line = (r, extra = '') => '- ' + state.label(r) + extra + ' (' + r.id + ')';
19	
20	  const sections = [
21	    ['Intent', of('intent', ['active']).sort(state.byTsDesc).slice(0, 5).map((r) => line(r))],
22	    ['Open tasks', of('task', state.OPEN_TASK).sort(state.byPriorityAge).slice(0, 10)
23	      .map((r) => line(r, ' — ' + r.status + (r.priority ? ', ' + r.priority : '')))],
24	    ['Open errors', of('error', state.OPEN_ERROR).sort(state.byTsDesc).slice(0, 10).map((r) => line(r, ' — ' + r.status))],
25	    ['Active decisions', of('decision', ['active']).sort(state.byTsDesc).slice(0, 10).map((r) => line(r))],
26	    ['Recent sessions', state.sessionsNewestFirst(index).filter((e) => e.summary).slice(0, 3)
27	      .map((e) => `- ${e.date} ${e.sid.slice(0, 8)}: ${state.oneLine(e.summary, 400)}`)]
28	  ];
29	
30	  const head = `MEMO project memory for ${path.basename(path.resolve(root))} (${all.length} records, ${index.length} sessions).`;
31	  const tail = 'Full detail: .memory/PROJECT_STATE.md';
32	  let out = head + '\n';
33	  for (const [title, items] of sections) {
34	    if (items.length === 0) continue;
35	    const block = '\n' + title + ':\n';
36	    if (out.length + block.length + tail.length + 2 > maxChars) break;
37	    out += block;
38	    for (const item of items) {
39	      if (out.length + item.length + tail.length + 3 > maxChars) break;
40	      out += item + '\n';
41	    }
42	  }
43	  return out + '\n' + tail + '\n';
44	}
45	
46	// Text for the current (or given) repo, or '' when the repo is not registered.
47	function contextFor(cwd) {
48	  let root;
49	  try { root = repoRoot(cwd); } catch (_) { return ''; }
50	  const repo = repos.find(root);
51	  if (!repo || repo.enabled === false) return '';
52	  if (!fs.existsSync(memoryDir(root))) return '';
53	  return buildContext(root);
54	}
55	
56	function command() {
57	  process.stdout.write(contextFor(process.cwd()));
58	}
59	
60	module.exports = { buildContext, contextFor, command, MAX_CHARS };
61
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5-5 2026-10-24 11:08:04Z)**_

Maine repo padha. Aapka sawal "session JSON ko kaise use karu" ek galat mental model se aa raha hai, aur wahi UX problem hai.

## Session JSON use nahi karna hota
`.memory/sessions/*.jsonl` raw archive hai. Isse aap ya agent seedha nahi padhte. Flow ye hai:

1. Hooks session capture karte hain.
2. `memo process` / `memo cycle` har 15 minute mein usse intents, tasks, errors aur decisions nikalta hai.
3. Ye `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` ban jata hai.
4. Agla Claude session shuru hone par `SessionStart` hook [src/context.js](src/context.js) ka summary apne aap context mein daal deta hai.

Is session ke start mein jo "Intent / Open errors / Active decisions" dikha, wahi iska output hai. Aapko kuch "attach" nahi karna. Problem ye hai ki ye kahin bataya nahi gaya aur README mein sirf `memo init` likha hai. Isliye user ko lagta hai ki JSON bana par kaam ka kuch nahi.

## Website par pivot nahi karna chahiye
- Memory repo ke andar `.memory/` mein Git ke saath rehti hai. Website par ye cloud aur account wala product ban jata hai, aur privacy ka sawal aa jata hai (`docs/SECURITY.md` ka poora point local-first hai).
- Har agent ke UI se connect karne ki zarurat nahi hai. Alag-alag agents ko jodne ka sabse sasta tareeka file hai:
  - Codex aur kai tools `AGENTS.md` khud padhte hain. Ye aapke `memo init` mein pehle se hai.
  - Gemini CLI `GEMINI.md` padhta hai, Cursor `.cursor/rules` padhta hai. Dono mein ek line likhni hai: "Read `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` first".
  - Isliye Codex ko poore adapter (P9) ke bina bhi basic support mil sakta hai. Capture baad ki baat hai, pehle read hona zaruri hai.

## UX ke liye kya karna chahiye (priority order)
1. **Ek command install**: `npx memo-cli init`, ya `npm i -g` ke baad `memo init`. Ye ek hi baar mein sab kare: repo setup, `memo setup claude`, scheduled task, aur key na ho to Groq key puchna. Abhi `git clone`, `node bin/memo.js install`, `init`, `setup claude` alag-alag hain, wahi thakane wala hissa hai.
2. **`memo init` ke end mein "Ab kya hoga" screen**: "Claude kholo, kaam karo. 15 min baad `memo status` chalao." Saath mein `memo status` mein "last captured session, kitne records bane" dikhao, taaki user ko proof mile ki ye kaam kar raha hai.
3. **`memo import`**: purane Claude sessions (`~/.claude/projects/...` ke transcripts) ek baar mein backfill karna. Aap "purani session add karna mushkil hai" bol rahe the, iska yahi hal hai. Capture code incremental offset se pehle hi transcripts padhta hai, to ye chhota kaam hai.
4. **`memo setup <agent>`**: `claude | codex | gemini | cursor` ek hi command se. Abhi sirf pehla chalta hai. Baaki teen ke liye shuru mein sirf instruction file likhni hai.
5. **Website sirf docs/landing page ho**, ya baad mein optional read-only viewer jo local `PROJECT_STATE.md` dikhaye. Model switch karne ki website zaruri nahi hai, kyunki memory model se independent file mein hai. Model badalna ek config line hai (`memo config`).

## Meri recommendation
Pivot mat karo. Ye hafte sirf teen kaam karo: one-command install, `memo import` (backfill), aur `AGENTS.md`/`GEMINI.md`/Cursor rules ki generic file writing. Is se "Claude se Codex mein jaane par bhi memory milti hai" ka demo bhi ban jata hai, aur hackathon ke liye wahi kaafi hai.

Agar chaho to main `memo import` ya `memo setup codex|gemini|cursor` mein se jo pehle chahiye woh bana deta hu.

Customer ko purana session "connect" nahi karna padta. Use sirf ek baar `init` karna hai, aur purani history ek command se aani chahiye. Ek baat pehle: `memo import` abhi repo mein nahi hai. Neeche "aaj" aur "banana hai" alag likha hai.

## User ke steps (target flow)

1. **Install, ek baar:** `npm i -g memo-cli`.
2. **Apne project folder mein:** `memo init`. Ye `.memory/` banata hai, Claude hooks lagata hai, aur background task register karta hai.
3. **Purani history lao (ek baar):** `memo import`. Ye us project ke purane Claude sessions dhoondhta hai. Wo `~/.claude/projects/<project>/*.jsonl` mein pehle se padhe hote hain. Screen par dikhata hai: "12 purane sessions mile. Import karu? [Y/n]". Phir wahi extraction chalata hai.
4. **Check karo:** `memo status` dikhata hai "12 sessions, 53 records, last: 2 hours ago". Ye proof hai ki purana session ab memory ban gaya.
5. **Kaam shuru karo:** Claude kholo. Purani memory (kaam, errors, decisions) session ke start mein apne aap aa jati hai. User ko kuch attach nahi karna.

## Purane session ka pata kaise chalega
- Claude Code purane sessions pehle se disk par rakhta hai, to user ko file dhoondhni nahi padti. `memo import` unhe project path se match karta hai.
- User ko kuch "dikhta" bhi chahiye: `memo sessions` ek list dikhaye, jaise `date | session id | summary ki pehli line`. Ye command repo mein pehle se hai. `memo show <id>` se poori detail dekh sakte hain.

## Aaj kya kaam karta hai
- `init`, `setup claude`, aur ab se hone wale sessions ka capture kaam karta hai.
- Purane sessions ke liye maine ye verify nahi kiya ki `memo cycle` ka sweep unhe uthata hai ya nahi. `docs/SUPPORTED_AGENTS.md` ke hisaab se sweep sirf "hooks ne jo miss kiya" wala hissa pakadta hai. Pakka jawab dene ke liye [src/capture/capture.js](src/capture/capture.js) padhna padega.

Chaho to main `capture.js` padhkar bata deta hu ki sweep purane transcripts uthata hai ya nahi, aur `memo import` ko chhote command ki tarah bana deta hu. Pehle code check karke hi bataunga ki kitna kaam hai.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5-5 2026-10-24 11:16:04Z)**_

## Saare purane sessions padhna: smart hai, par limit ke saath
**Faida:** pehle din hi project ka context mil jata hai (kya bana, kaunse errors, kaunse decisions). Isse product "kaam ka" lagta hai.

**Dikkat:**
- **Cost aur time:** har session LLM (Groq) se guzarta hai. 200 sessions ek saath bhejoge to token aur wait dono lagenge.
- **Purani info galat ho sakti hai:** 3 mahine purana "TODO" ab ho chuka ho sakta hai. Use "open task" dikhana bura hai.
- **Privacy:** purane sessions mein secrets ya personal baatein ho sakti hain. Redaction hai, par user ko pata hona chahiye ki kya bheja ja raha hai.

**Isliye aise karo:**
1. Default mein sirf **pichle 30 din ya 10-20 sessions** import karo. `memo import --all` alag option ho.
2. Chalane se pehle batao: "14 sessions, andaza ~X tokens, Groq ko bheje jayenge. Continue? [Y/n]".
3. Purane sessions se sirf **decisions aur errors** lo. Tasks ko "unverified" ya "old" mark karo, taaki wo aaj ke kaam jaise na dikhein.

## Claude, Gemini, Codex, Copilot ko kaise pata chalega
Inhe memo ke baare mein pata nahi hota. Har tool ek **instruction file** padhta hai, aur hum us file mein ek line likhte hain: "Pehle `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` padho".

| Agent | Kaise padhta hai | Humara kaam |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `SessionStart` hook se context apne aap aata hai, plus `CLAUDE.md` | pehle se hai |
| Codex | `AGENTS.md` | `memo init` mein pehle se hai |
| Gemini CLI | `GEMINI.md` | `memo init` mein ek chhoti file likhni hai |
| Copilot | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | `memo init` mein ek chhoti file likhni hai |
| Cursor | `.cursor/rules/` | `memo init` mein ek chhoti file likhni hai |

Ye file-naam mere yaad se hain. Inhe `memo setup` mein daalne se pehle docs se confirm kar lena.

**Fark kya hai:** Claude ko memory **push** hoti hai, yaani apne aap aati hai. Baaki ko sirf instruction file milti hai, to wo **pull** karte hain. Agent chahe to file padhe, chahe to na padhe. Isliye unke liye bharosa kam hota hai, aur capture (agent se naya session wapas memory mein aana) abhi sirf Claude ka hai.

**Ek kaam ki baat:** `PROJECT_STATE.md` ek hi file hai aur sab agents wahi padhte hain. Isliye Claude mein kiya kaam Codex ko dikhta hai, bina kisi website ya UI ke. Model badalna asaan hone ka asli reason yahi hai.

Agle step mein main `memo init` mein Gemini, Copilot aur Cursor ki instruction files likhwa deta hu. Ye chhota kaam hai, aur ek tool se doosre tool jaane ka demo bhi isse chal jata hai.

Copilot ko pata nahi tha kyunki repo mein uske liye koi instruction file nahi thi. Ab `memo init` `.github/copilot-instructions.md` likhta hai.

**Wajah:** Claude ko memory hook se milti hai, par Copilot mein hook nahi hota. Wo sirf `.github/copilot-instructions.md` jaisi file padhta hai, aur `memo init` ye file nahi banata tha.

**Fix:**
- [src/init.js](src/init.js) ab wahi marked memory block `.github/copilot-instructions.md` mein likhta hai. Dobara chalane par block duplicate nahi hota.
- Is repo mein `memo init` chala diya, to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` ban gayi. `AGENTS.md` mein bhi memory block add hua, kyunki pehle wo wahan tha hi nahi.
- `npm test`: 172 pass, 0 fail.

**Ab Copilot mein:** nayi chat kholo aur pucho "`.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` padh ke bata ye project kya hai". Copilot memory apne aap push nahi karta, wo file padhega tabhi jawab dega. Pehle wali chat purani instructions ke saath khuli thi, isliye use mat use karo. Ye Copilot ka behaviour maine live check nahi kiya.

**Dhyan dena:** Copilot chat mein `groq_key.md` attach tha. Ye file gitignored hai, par Copilot ke context mein jane se key bhej di jati hai. Use detach kar do, aur key `memo key set` wale store mein hi rakho.

Commit abhi nahi kiya. Chaho to diff ke saath commit kar deta hu. `.specstory` aur `.memory/sessions` ki changes alag hain, unhe commit mein nahi daalunga.
